ContactSubmissions.title: Contact Submissions
ContactSubmissions.description: Direct reader inquiries, feedback, and editorial submissions sent through the Contact Us form

category.description: Department or category selected in contact form

message.description: All details and message content entered in contact form

userId.description: Optional user UID if signed in
